newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SHEFFIELD WEDNESDAY SET TO SIGN IN-FORM SPANISH STRIKER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SHEFFIELD WEDNESDAY SET TO SIGN IN-FORM SPANISH STRIKER.

text.p: English premier league club Sheffield Wednesday are set to sign the Spanish second division's leading scorer, Moises Garcia, from Leganes for an undisclosed fee.

"We're still in negotiations and I don't think anything will be concluded this side of the weekend but we hope we can complete the signing sometime next week," Wednesday secretary Graham Mackrell said.
Garcia is a left-sided forward known for his strength in the air. He has scored 14 times in 16 games at Leganes, the club he joined in the close season after spells at Osasuna and Zaragoza.
"We buying him as a squad player really. We don't envisage him walking straight into the first team," Mackrell said.
